summary: ansible-core 2.11 moved argument spec validation to ArgumentSpecValidator and removed several private AnsibleModule methods as a result.
questions: Why did my module calling AnsibleModule._check_arguments break in 2.11?

answer_card.title: AnsibleModule private validators removed
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.11 validates argument specs with **`ArgumentSpecValidator`**, and the private `AnsibleModule._check_*` / `_handle_*` helper methods were removed. Use public functions from `ansible.module_utils.common.validation` or `ArgumentSpecValidator.validate()`.
